name: Occidental-Quoin
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond a nearby asteroid belt, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (warship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
